[attribute-comm-ref-group-type]
=== `@comm-ref-group-type` Committee Reference Group Type

The element <<element-comm-ref,`<comm-ref>`>> identifies the Technical Committee, Subcommittee, or Working Group responsible for the standard, for example, “`ISO/TC 27/SC 4`”. The element <<element-comm-ref-group,`<comm-ref-group>`>> holds multiple standards-producing groups to create a hierarchy of groups, since the element may contain a <<element-comm-ref,`<comm-ref>`>> element to name itself, a series of lower-level <<element-comm-ref,`<comm-ref>`>>s, as well as lower-level <<element-comm-ref-group,`<comm-ref-group>`>>s. This <<attribute-comm-ref-group-type,`@comm-ref-group-type`>> attribute names the type of group, for example, “`partner`” or “`sponsor`”.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-comm-ref-group,`<comm-ref-group>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The type of group, for example, “`partner`”.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
